business_problem: Wenzhou Education Bureau needed a city-level platform to coordinate AI education resources, lower the barrier to offering AI courses, and strengthen teacher training and curriculum planning across many schools.
solution_summary: Wenzhou Education Bureau and Tencent Education built a city-level AI education cloud platform to make AI instruction easier to plan, teach, govern, and scale across the city's schools. The platform combines lesson-preparation and teaching workflows, a teaching-resource center, a programming creation center, an AI training center, and smart teacher-training services in one service model. Tencent's AI technology supports a three-tier city-district-school management model so resources, curriculum plans, and delivery status can be coordinated centrally rather than left to each campus. The program also pairs the platform with curriculum planning, staged course-system design, teacher-development plans, and a joint teaching-research team that brings educators closer to practical AI engineering. By treating content, training, and governance as one cloud service, Wenzhou lowers the barrier to opening AI courses, improves management efficiency, and builds a regional model for AI education.

solution_components.name: AI Education Cloud Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared citywide service layer for AI teaching and management.

solution_components.name: Teaching Resource Center
solution_components.role: Stores and organizes course resources for coordinated citywide use.

solution_components.name: Programming Creation Center
solution_components.role: Provides students and teachers with a shared environment for programming-based AI learning.

solution_components.name: AI Training Center
solution_components.role: Supports hands-on AI training experiences inside the education platform.

solution_components.name: Smart Teacher Training
solution_components.role: Delivers standardized teacher-development services for AI instruction.

data_flow: Teaching resources, curriculum plans, and school implementation data flow into the citywide platform, where resource-center, programming, training, and teacher-development services are delivered back to schools through a unified city-district-school operating model.
business_outcome: Wenzhou gained a coordinated AI education operating model that improves resource governance, teacher capability building, and course rollout while creating a reusable regional benchmark for AI education.
architecture_clues: The platform uses a three-tier city, district, and school model.
The program includes both technology delivery and supporting curriculum, teacher, and research mechanisms.
Tencent positioned the service as a city-level cloud platform rather than a single-school tool.
